We have mass spec showing molecular ion at m/z 224.1201. Likely molecular weight ~224.12. Need to infer formula. We guessed C16H16O (mass: C16=192, H16=16, O=16 => 224). Yes matches. So formula C16H16O.

Now need to determine SMILES. Use isomers list. Need to pick correct one based on other spectra (not yet obtained). We should get NMR data to narrow. Use carbon and proton NMR.
